permittedUse: Implement adapter-neutral fixture assertions in an isolated offline test harness. Do not call a database, network, Mac, production service, or downstream dispatcher.

layers.offline_registry: Executable acceptance for pure registry/legacy compatibility planner; no storage guarantees inferred.
layers.semantic_reducer: Semantic/action-proposal expectations; adapt existing private semantic reducer where needed.
layers.future_persistence_gate: Finite fault-injection rollout gates only; not implemented or executed by this acceptance specification.

assertionDsl.same: Outputs for listed records must have equal non-null values in field.
assertionDsl.pairwise_distinct: Outputs for listed records must all have distinct non-null values in field.
assertionDsl.equals: Named adapter result path must equal value, including full list equality where the result is a list.

oracleNotes: recordId and fixture source IDs are local labels, not proposed production IDs. The adapter may not use recordId as sourceClaimId.
No fixture author or original ID represents a real verified report except where a frozen exact audited text is explicitly identified. Synthetic verified provenance is an input precondition only.
All records within a case are retained; no overwrite or silent deletion is allowed.
All cases have zero actual external sends/writes/dispatches. Counts refer only to hypothetical retained records and pure proposals/plans.
sourceClaimId represents a source occurrence. Distinct source occurrences may converge on the same scenario/revision/effect.
Equal scenarioRevisionId never proves that a legacy delivery was absent or authorizes retransmission.
Newly actionable resolution requires verified binding, explicit new interpretation, and proof of no prior delivered effect. Post-effect material rebinding stays held.
As-of, first-acceptance, validity and immutable source times stay distinct. Later evidence cannot backdate an action or refresh validity.
Corrections/retractions are held relations in the first slice. No reversal or compensation authority is implied.
Legacy keys in CR001 are diagnostic reconstruction keys, never verified retained historical IDs.
Interpretation version equality for evidence-only changes is deliberately not asserted until the final contract decides whether interpretation versions link evidence derivations.
All persistence/retry counts are design acceptance requirements, not evidence that PostgreSQL constraints, atomicity or delivery idempotency exist.

fieldProjectionContract.sourceClaimId: Stable allocated source occurrence identity; never recordId, display offset, resolved player, fact or scenario hash.
fieldProjectionContract.evidenceVersionId: Immutable version of source text + subject/governing/display context + evidence rule version.
fieldProjectionContract.interpretationVersionId: Immutable interpretation derivation; may include an evidence-version reference.
fieldProjectionContract.resolvedSemantics: Canonical projection of verified resolved subject, bound scope, fact, polarity, assertion strength, modality, applicability/effective time and validation outcome; excludes parser/evidence version identifiers and display offsets.
fieldProjectionContract.scenarioId: Canonical bound scope and predicate slot. Availability includes subject; starter slot is team/game.
fieldProjectionContract.scenarioRevisionId: Material fact value, effective time/interval and explicit relation under the scenario; excludes evidence/parser version.
fieldProjectionContract.effectId: Stable effectKind+scenarioId+persisted transitionId identity. A pure proposal is not a delivery or authorization.
fieldProjectionContract.firstAcceptanceClocksUnchanged: Original first-acceptance source publication, receipt, availability, effective and validUntil clocks remain unchanged by representation replay or corroboration.
fieldProjectionContract.sharedPredicateSpan: Exact predicateSpan shared by two independently named subject slots in one governing clause.

adapterRequirements: Map implementation-specific fields and normalized hold reasons to the fieldProjectionContract. Do not derive IDs from fixture record labels.
A result count means distinct retained identities or pure proposals at the declared case end, never actual external execution.
Where preconditions include durable state, preload an isolated fixture ledger. Do not infer that state from a failure code.
CR037 lists four finite immutable conflict variants; execute one separately for each listed field.
Cases tagged future_persistence_gate remain required design gates and must never be reported as passed merely because the pure planner passes.
An implementation coverage report must list case IDs executed, assertions checked, and every skipped/unimplemented case. An adapter is not supplied by this specification.
Numeric synthetic original/relay IDs and short fixture author handles are deliberately structurally valid. They are not real verified platform identities.

Copy exact lexical subjectSpan, predicateSpan, governingClauseSpan and contextSpans. Use the target API text-version helper where its domain-separated sourceTextVersionId format differs from the fixture raw-text hash label.
Allocate/reuse a sourceRootId from proven lineage, including persisted provisional roots. Do not recompute a provisional sourceClaimId when original provenance resolves.
Map fixture polarity affirmed to an API positive enum if required, and scenarioRevisionId to revisionId if required. This is enum/field adaptation only, not changing the semantic oracle.
